text: Phase 0 gate complete. sbt representationProof passed 4 JVM and 6 JS tests with fullLinkJS. javap shows primitive double[] loop with daload/dadd/dastore and no generic calls. Optimized JS shows direct Float64Array indexed loop. Node baseline ~705M elements/s. Short JMH baselines ~67.5k contiguous and ~70.9k strided ops/s; second measured iterations ~0.1 B/op and no GC. Evidence: docs/representation-proof.md.
